items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels ruled out with left elbow injury (dislocated); carted off, prior similar injury missed 4 games; further testing Monday.
items.why: Awkward bend/dislocation in-game; confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport/Quinn.
items.implication: Major blow; multi-week absence possible; backup QB elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Commanders skill players via pass volume change or run-heavy.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; walking under own power with slight limp, imaging Monday, tests tomorrow.
items.why: In-game injury; positive that walking no crutches.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 3; possible miss or limited.
items.opportunity: Backup QB (Bagent?) if misses; skill player adjustments.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is officially active today despite cracked rib injury; expected to wear flak jacket.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, team optimistic per Rapoport; confirmed active by Schefter and Berry.
items.implication: Remains viable WR2 with possible docks for injury; flak jacket may limit some mobility but playable.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected if no setback; monitor snap share early.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today with hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring issue; ETR/Levitan not expected, confirmed inactive by Schefter/Berry.
items.implication: Opens backfield for backups; stash/look at handcuff options.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for next man up (Jonah Coleman per analysts).

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed questionable with back, is officially active vs Texans.
items.why: Back soreness but expected/will play per Rapoport and Schefter confirmations; ETR expected.
items.implication: Full QB1 projection; no major docks anticipated.
items.opportunity: Normal passing volume, red-zone usage intact.

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return due to chest injury.
items.implication: Monitor; rookie usage impacted if out.
items.opportunity: More for other Seahawks RBs if limited.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans has hip injury and is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; if out rest of way, targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: More for other 49ers WRs/TEs if limited/out.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Potential limited or out remainder; handcuff ready.
items.opportunity: Increased role for Gainwell or others if limited.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave is active; expected to play through hamstring.
items.why: Expected to play per Schefter/Rapoport; ETR/Levitan clean with no docks.
items.implication: WR1/2 value intact; full target share likely.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status late (2:30pm ET window).
items.why: Optimism + flak jacket; improved more than expected.
items.implication: Startable but docked production vs full health.

items.text: Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey sounding doubtful/not expected.
items.implication: Coleman elevated role in Broncos backfield.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, potential goal-line for Coleman.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT.
items.why: Aggravated hamstring; confirmed OUT across reports and inactives.
items.implication: Significant target vacuum in Ravens offense.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WRs like Bateman.

items.why: Foot injury; listed OUT in ETR summary and inactives.
items.opportunity: Decent look at Germie Bernard (YAC fit) per Levitan/Berry.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is a pre-game/true GTD for MNF vs Giants and trending in the wrong direction.
items.why: Hip issue different from prior; DNP practice, Schefter notes wrong direction; ETR true GTD.
items.implication: High risk of missing; contingency needed for MNF.
items.opportunity: If out, more for Adams/Williams/TEs; if in, full role.

items.text: Agrees on Germie Bernard stash (YAC man, good fit with McCarthy); Pittman out creates opportunity.
Chris Olave (hamstring) sounds fine with no real docks in projections.
items.why: Expected to play cleanly per reports.

items.text: Expecting decent look at Germie Bernard with Michael Pittman (foot) out.
items.implication: Bernard as stash/potential flex in deeper leagues.
